title: The Cod Wars: The Navy Defeated by a Net Cutter
summary: It tells how Iceland, a country without even an army, unilaterally extended its fishing limit from four miles to two hundred miles between nineteen fifty-eight and nineteen seventy-six, faced the Royal Navy three times, and won that fight. The episode ranges from a simple steel cutter that severed trawl nets to the NATO base at Keflavík being placed on the bargaining table, and to the collapse of British fishing towns.
